_comment: Smallest useful spec: one standalone schema with no Response/Body/Opt suffix, exercising every scalar type mapping plus required-field handling. No paths, so no method generation.

id.description: An ID that identifies the user.

view_count.description: Number of times the channel has been viewed.

ratio.description: A float, distinguished from integer only by its format.

score.description: A number with no format maps to int, not float.

is_live.description: Whether the user is currently live.

raw_settings.description: An object with no properties falls back to Dictionary.

untyped.description: No type at all falls back to Variant.
